Unlike the Effort-v0.3 paper (which states equations in its own prose that this pipeline can extract near-verbatim), the UPCC source documents (UPCC Master v1.3, Curriculum Production System v1.3, UPCC-Core Institute Schema v2.0) never themselves construct a formal tuple/state/transition/quotient for any of these four objects -- they describe the objects only in prose/schema form. Every formal_tuple, gate verdict, and draft LaTeX statement in this file is THIS SESSION'S OWN Genesis-compatibility formalization of the UPCC prose, produced by applying the reuse pipeline (Toledo lookup -> Genesis compatibility -> reuse -> derive only the missing piece -> mark PROPOSAL) to registry/CANONICAL.json (read this session) and READOUT_GENESIS_CORE.md's own gate criteria (Exact Domain Gate / Reader Equivalence-Commuting-Square / Sufficiency / Lineage Preservation). This is a Dr-tier reading -- a declared, narrative formalization exercise -- never a machine-checked (Th_coqc) or finite_diagnostic result, and none of these four objects has been through registrar review or Coq formalization; two of the four (CURRICULUM_TRACEABILITY_RECORD, ROUTE_DEPENDENCY_RECORD) were found, under this session's own gate audit, to FAIL or leave OPEN at least one Genesis gate as currently scoped -- this is reported plainly per the Clay/OPEN-status honesty rule, not smoothed over. Code slots EQ-015/H.57 through EQ-015/H.60 were picked as the next genuinely free EQ-015/H numbers after the existing EQ-015/H.01-56 range (confirmed by a listing of existing codes in this batch's working session, no collision). Several cited Toledo parents were given to this session only as bare internal reference ids (CAN-172, CAN-174, CAN-237, CAN-249, CAN-102) without their own dotted Toledo code resolved in the same pass that resolved CAN-171/CAN-103/CAN-082/CAN-104/CAN-087/CAN-106 to their dotted codes -- these are carried here as the bare CAN-id and flagged with a drift_note each, for a reviewer to resolve to a dotted code (or confirm no dotted code exists yet) before this proposal is registered. This file is NEW ORIGINAL CONTENT (this session's formalization of UPCC prose) -- none of it is copied from CANONICAL.json, genesis_root.json, LINEAGE.jsonl, coq/, latex/, or mcp/, and none of those were edited.

statement.latest:
z^{CER}_{i} := \langle\, TargetClaim_{i},\ ObservedTask_{i},\ MechanicalValidity_{i},\ SemanticFit_{i},\ TransferDistance_{i},\ WarrantedClaimStrength_{i},\ EvidenceStatus_{i},\ Evaluator_{i},\ Creator_{i},\ \Lambda_{i} \,\rangle\\[4pt]
\text{s.t.}\quad WarrantedClaimStrength_{i} \le EvidenceStrength_{i} \quad\text{[CAN-174]}\\
MechanicalValidity_{i} \ne SemanticFit_{i} \quad\text{[CAN-237, instantiated]}\\
Evaluator_{i} \ne Creator_{i} \quad\text{[CAN-249]}\\
EvidenceStatus_{i} \in \{Source, AI\text{-}Synthesis, Human\text{-}Inference, Candidate, Decision\} \quad\text{[CAN-172]}\\
\Lambda_{i} = \Lambda(e_{i}) = \langle Prov_{i}, Tier_{i}, Def_{i}, Reader_{i}, Falsifier_{i}\rangle \quad\text{[CAN-171]}\\[6pt]
F_{CER}:\ z^{CER}_{i} \mapsto z^{CER}_{i+1} = z^{CER}_{i} \boxplus \Lambda(e_{i+1})\\[6pt]
\mathcal{Q}_{CER} = \text{``how much does this observed task warrant that the target claim actually transferred, and to whom is that warrant attributable?''}\\[6pt]
q_{CER}:\quad z^{CER}_{i} \sim z^{CER}_{j} \iff TargetClaim_{i}{=}TargetClaim_{j} \wedge \text{SemanticFit-class}_{i}{=}\text{SemanticFit-class}_{j} \wedge \text{TransferDistance-bracket}_{i}{=}\text{TransferDistance-bracket}_{j} \wedge MechanicalValidity_{i}{=}MechanicalValidity_{j}\\
\text{(licensed only when } MechanicalValidity \text{ equality is independently verified first; individual } \Lambda_i \text{ entries are never merged by this quotient).}

z_{SCR}[i,k,n] := \big\langle \text{Attempt}_n,\ s_n \in \{0,\dots,s_{max}\},\ \text{BarrierTag}_n \in \mathcal{B}^{bar}\ (\text{CAN-102}),\ \text{FeedbackGiven}_n,\ \text{Outcome}_n \in \{\text{Success},\text{Fail}\},\ \text{ReattemptCount}_n \big\rangle_{n=0}^{N} \\[4pt]
F_{SCR}:\ z_{SCR}[i,k,n] \mapsto z_{SCR}[i,k,n+1] = \begin{cases} s_{n+1} = \min\{s \ge s_n : \text{Sufficient}(s)\}, \ \text{BarrierTag}_n \leftarrow \text{CAN-102 ledger} & \text{Outcome}_n=\text{Fail} \\ s_{n+1} = s_n - 1 & \text{Outcome}_n=\text{Success},\ s_n>0 \\ \text{UnaidedExecutionFlag} \leftarrow 1,\ \text{halt fading} & \text{Outcome}_n=\text{Success},\ s_n=0,\ \forall\, n{-}k_{min}{<}m{\le}n \end{cases} \\[4pt]
\mathcal{Q}_{SCR}:\ \text{``Did } (i,k) \text{ reach stable unaided competence via Attempt} \to \text{Minimal Sufficient Scaffold} \to \text{Feedback} \to \text{Reattempt} \to \text{Fading} \to \text{Unaided Execution (CAN-104), and if not, which typed barrier (CAN-102, Observed Difficulty} \ne \text{Skill Deficit) is stalling it?''} \\[4pt]
q_{SCR}(z) = q_{SCR}(z') \iff (s_n,\text{BarrierTag}_n,\text{Outcome}_n) = (s'_n,\text{BarrierTag}'_n,\text{Outcome}'_n)\ \ \big[\text{licensed only under the stated, unproven auxiliary claim that } s_{n+1} \text{ is a function of this triple alone}\big]
